title: orchestrator meta_loop-aware boot: announce autonomous mode instead of asking
description: The orchestrator boot prompt (buildOrchestratorBootPrompt, src/commands/run.ts:155-188) is a static string that never reads meta_loop, and the persona (.claude/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md:106) unconditionally ends boot with the question What would you like to do. With meta_loop=auto the sidecar auto-dispatches out-of-band while the orchestrator pane sits at an operator prompt: the two visibly disagree about who drives (observed 2026-07-06: pane asking what to do while the sidecar had already dispatched CAM-118 to planning). Fix direction: (a) the boot prompt injects the resolved meta_loop value and the current drain-precondition status; (b) the persona branches on it: when auto and preconditions hold, the greeting announces autonomous drain (live backlog counts, next plannable issue) and does NOT end with an operator question, only narrates; when off or observe, or when a precondition refuses, keep the current ask and surface the refuse reason. Consumes the evented refusals and durable blocked marker from CAM-195. Cross-refs: CAM-190 (boot derives backlog live via cam issue list), CAM-195 (wedge recovery and refusal events), CAM-139 (meta-loop shipped).
